get.description:
Used to get a list of all of the client's children:
1. MCD gets a list of children from RC
2. MCD gets a list of children with which the parent has a Guardian relation.
3. MCD joins those two lists and returns a single list of children.

Only those children that have an mcdId will have a card in MCD. Therefore, after child data is entered in Infinity, if a child without an mcdId was selected, a Create physical prospect request must be send, but if the child already had an mcdId, an Update physical person request must be sent. Set junior guardian request can be sent in both cases.

put.description:
Used to create juridical (SME) client card in MCD.
Both juridical client and representative data must be passed. If the client / representative already exists, their data will be updated and returned. If they do not, they will be created.
During creation, representation relationship is validated. If validation fails, no entities are created and an error is returned.
SME country defaults to LT, other countries are not supported.

put.description:
Used to create a juridical (SME) accumulated client card in MCD.
Both juridical client and representative data must be passed. If the client / representative already exists, their data will be updated and returned. If they do not, they will be created.
The caller is responsible for ensuring that the relation between the juridical person and the representative is valid, since no validation can be done on MCD side. A Founder relation is created.
SME country defaults to LT, other countries are not supported.
If a company, that is not accumulative is found, error is returned.

get.description:
Used to check if juridical (SME) accumulated client exists. Will only return juridical clients of the establishing type that have not yet completed transformation.
Before comparison, both values are cast to lowercase and quotes (both single and double) are removed, so "Artea" Lizingas should match Artea lizingas.

post.description:
Used to transform an accumulated accound into a proper SME account.
Fails if any validations fail. Validations triggered:
- Is the specified SME customer an establishing customer
- Is there such a customer according to JAR integration
- Does the company name we get from JAR match the one we have in MCD
- Is the specified representative an actual representative according to RC JAR 

If any of the validations fail, the update results are not saved (representative is not created, company is not updated).
If all validations succeed, the account is transformed from establishing into a full SME account, and SME account data is updated according to JAR.
